texts.Message_43600405: Oh, really? I always feel like you're constantly busy...
texts.Message_43600407: If you're free... would you want to meet up today?
texts.Option01_43600408: That's exactly what I was thinking!
texts.Option02_43600408: I'll go along with whatever you say today!
texts.Message_43600409: Great minds think alike. Let me work out my schedule, one moment
texts.Message_43600410: Alright. Proxy, I have the entire day free. Where are we heading?
texts.Option01_43600411: Want to come over to my place?
texts.Option02_43600411: How about we get some fresh air at Port Elpis?
texts.Message_43600412: Huh? Go to your place? Is that okay?
texts.Message_43600413: Spending my saved-up vacation days to stay at your place... Isn't that a bit extravagant?
texts.Option02_43600414: Sometimes you should treat yourself to luxury!
texts.Message_43600415: Would you mind picking me up at the metro station? I think the metro would be the easiest way to get to your place
texts.Message_43600416: Though I haven't figured out what we're going to do yet... I'm already looking forward to it
texts.Message_43600418: Over by the port? Proxy, we always seem to think alike.
texts.Message_43600419: Walking along the wooden boards on the dock, feeling the sea breeze, playing the harmonica for a while... I'd really enjoy that, it brings back so many memories.
texts.Message_43600420: Ah, that's just what I had in mind... Proxy, would you find it boring?
texts.Option02_43600421: I'd love to take a walk together too
texts.Message_43600422: That's a relief... Let's meet at the port boardwalk then. I'm free anytime
texts.Message_43600424: As long as I get to see you, I'm fine with going anywhere
texts.Message_43600426: I feel the same way. I've been so focused on chatting with you that I set aside my gun maintenance
texts.Message_43600427: Oh, so you have nothing to do today...
texts.Message_43600428: If you're free, want to meet up today?
texts.Message_43600430: Is there anything I can help you with?
texts.Option01_43600431: Yes, let's go out and have some fun!
texts.Option02_43600431: No, I just wanted to see you

texts.Message_43600433: Plus, with the vacation days I've saved up, we can go anywhere and do whatever we like
texts.Option01_43600434: Is there any place you want to go?
texts.Option02_43600434: Is there anything you want to do?
texts.Message_43600435: Personally, I'd like to go somewhere quiet. There's been too much gunfire lately...
texts.Message_43600436: ...No, actually, this time I want to hear your decision, Proxy. As long as I'm spending time with you, it feels like a refreshing break for me
texts.Message_43600437: Where would you like to go?
texts.Message_43600438: Personally, I've wanted to play the harmonica for ages, but I've been so busy with missions lately...
texts.Message_43600439: Looks like we're on the same page
texts.Message_43600440: Can we meet up? I'll organize my work accordingly

texts.Message_43600503: Find a safe place to hide. I'll be there soon
texts.Message_43600505: ...I'm sorry, I overreacted. I'm glad you're okay
texts.Message_43600506: If it's a "need" in a non-dangerous situation... can I take it to mean you want to meet?
texts.Option02_43600507: What about you, Trigger? Do you want to see me?

texts.Message_43600516: To be honest, I'm curious about what a massage feels like... Will it be painful, or will it tickle?
texts.Message_43600517: Let's meet at the parking lot in Lumina Square. I have a feeling this will be a really interesting experience...

texts.Option01_43600520: I might get to know some people there
texts.Option02_43600520: I've got some history with that place

texts.Option01_44600201: Seed, anything interesting going on lately~

texts.Message_44600203: Ooh, or maybe you'd rather hear about how that annoying officer who came to inspect us the other day got three ribs cracked by Seed Sr....
texts.Option02_44600204: Except for the last one... they all seem pretty interesting!
texts.Message_44600205: If you wanna to hear more, I can talk for ages~ If we keep chatting on Knock Knock, we'll definitely drain our phones dry~
texts.Option01_44600206: I feel like you've been chatting more on Knock Knock lately...
texts.Option02_44600206: You really like chatting on Knock Knock
texts.Message_44600207: Really~ I think it's because of you! Like how sunflowers react to sunlight, it's probably that kind of feeling~
texts.Message_44600208: Don't believe me? We can meet up anytime~ Seed can do much more than just type on a keyboard~
texts.Option02_44600209: Tell me your fun stories in person~

texts.Message_44600211: Proxy, have you figured out where we're headed?

texts.Option01_44600216: What kind of place is it? Take me there!

texts.Message_44600218: So, I'll be waiting at the Lumina Square parking lot~ Let's keep this between us!
texts.Message_44600220: Speaking of Failume Heights, did you know there's a Bangboo Kingdom there~?

texts.Option01_44600222: Hate to break it to you, but I don't understand...
texts.Option02_44600222: I have no idea what that means, but it sounds impressive!
texts.Message_44600223: So you don't know, huh~ Well then, as a Friend of Bangboo, I'll take you there~
texts.Message_44600224: See you at the cable car station in Failume Heights! Oh, and when interacting with Bangboo, remember to use lots of Bangboo language! I'll show you how it's done~

texts.Message_44600227: As for Seed Sr.'s current location... since auto-cruise mode is on, even I don't know~ Let's just let Seed Sr. go wherever he wants in this millitary camp~

texts.Message_44600229: You wanna join? Welcome en-nah~ Though the movie I'm watching isn't publicly available, I strapped a camera to an Armored Hati's neck in the Hollow two days ago &%￥#
texts.Message_44600231: I'm fine~ Hey Proxy, how about I come over to your place instead? We can watch a movie together another time~
texts.Message_44600232: By the way, got any tips on how to quietly dispose of knocked-out high-ranking military officers? Just asking for... research purposes~
texts.Option01_44600233: Maybe you should turn yourself in...
texts.Option02_44600233: Pretend you didn't see and scram!
texts.Message_44600235: So, I better stay away from the camp before they find that officer I bumped into. I'll head over to where you are now~ Let's do something fun!
texts.Message_44600237: You get it! Seed Sr. switched to high-speed mode~

texts.Option02_44600304: Nitro-Fuel is always mixed using two or more ingredients!
texts.Message_44600306: What do you think about changing the recipe for catnip water?
texts.Option01_44600307: I recommend a custom Bangboo Ether Battery~
texts.Option02_44600307: Cats love fresh fish way more than canned food
texts.Message_44600308: I totally get it~ I'll follow your suggestion and head out today~ You can pick the event, Proxy!
texts.Option01_44600309: What the heck did I just say...
texts.Option02_44600309: Actually, I just made all that up...
texts.Message_44600310: Proxy, I don't think you could've made such a solid point without giving it some serious thought~?
texts.Message_44600311: But if you need me to explain... you'll need to decide when and where we meet up, 'cause we're gonna hang out~
texts.Option01_44600312: How about going to Fantasy Resort together?
texts.Option02_44600312: Wanna hang at my place for a bit?
texts.Message_44600313: Hmm~? We hitting the beach together? But I don't have a swimsuit, you know?
texts.Message_44600314: Besides, I don't really see myself as the outdoorsy type who splashes around at the beach in a swimsuit~
texts.Option02_44600315: Just wanna take a walk with you by the seaside
texts.Message_44600316: Oh, really! In that case, I'm totally in the mood for a nice beach stroll right now~
texts.Message_44600317: As long as you promise to hold my hand and not let me fall into the water, it should be fine!
texts.Message_44600318: Alright, Proxy, let's meet at the entrance of Fantasy Resort! Time for some summer fun~
texts.Message_44600320: Your home? Not Suibian Temple, but your place on Sixth Street~?
texts.Message_44600321: I have an idea for hanging out at your place~ Isn't the other Proxy still at Suibian Temple practicing their spells, unable to come home?
texts.Message_44600323: I wanna check out the other Proxy's room~ I've always wondered what {M#her}{F#his} life is like, bet it's as fascinating as a midnight bloom~
texts.Message_44600324: Ah, if you're worried about privacy... when we see something we shouldn't, I'll cover both our eyes~
texts.Option01_44600325: Privacy's not really an issue for our rooms... but why?
texts.Option02_44600325: Why do you suddenly want to check out {M#her}{F#his} room?
texts.Message_44600326: Hmm... Just a whim? I think it's important for you to get more familiar with your loved one's living environment too. It's quite meaningful~
texts.Message_44600327: Since privacy isn't an issue, let's do it~ Meet me at the Sixth Street metro entrance later, bye-bye~
texts.Message_44600331: En-neh wah-dah en-neh~ wah-dah wah-dah en-neh~
texts.Option01_44600332: Sorry, that's all I can make up
texts.Option02_44600332: My knowledge of Bangboo is quite limited...
texts.Message_44600333: Eh... Proxy, that's so mean... Were all those things you just said nothing but lies?!
texts.Message_44600334: And here I was getting all excited!
texts.Option01_44600335: What the heck did I just en-nah...
texts.Option02_44600335: Sorry... But I'll fulfill whatever I said!
texts.Message_44600336: You said "I want to hang out with you, rain or shine, and no one's gonna stop us"~ You'll keep your word, right~?
texts.Option01_44600337: So... where do you wanna go, Seed?
texts.Message_44600338: Since you agreed, it'd be pushing my luck to ask for more. Squad Member Phaethon, you got any ideas~?
texts.Message_44600340: Chill, chill, it's not some outrageous request~ I just wanna monopolize you for today, that's all~

texts.Option02_402401403: As an officer, you have to get to know the public more. Want to tag along?

texts.Option01_402401405: You're sharp as a tack, ma'am.
texts.Message_402401407: Call me by my name properly; there's no need for all this back-and-forth formal addressing. I can go with you.

texts.Message_402401515: You pick the movie. You're the expert.
